articles.title: HEARTBOT AI Wins Chunghwa Telecom Special Award at Meet Neo Star 2026
articles.description: Named to the top 30 from more than 200 startups, AnyInsight won over judges with its zero-trust approach to AI governance TAIPEI, Nov. 22, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- HEARTBOT AI has won the Chunghwa Telecom Special Award at Meet Neo Star 2026, the startup competition held during the Meet Taipei Startup Festival. CEO Nathan Yen pitched AnyInsight, the company's enterprise AI security and governance platform, at the Meet Neo Star Demo Show Final on November 20, showing judges how companies can expand their use of AI agents without losing control of their data. HEARTBOT AI receives the Chunghwa Telecom Special Award from a representative at Meet Neo Star 2026 Alongside the judges' awards, sponsors selected startups from the top 30 for their own prizes. HEARTBOT AI received the Chunghwa Telecom Special Award from Chunghwa Telecom (CHT), which includes priority eligibility for the final selection of the CHT 5G Accelerator Batch 9, CHT hicloud credits and opportunities to connect and collaborate with CHT business units. Meet Taipei ran November 19 to 21 at Taipei Expo Park and drew more than 550 startups from 23 countries, its largest edition to date. In October, AnyInsight also received the ASOCIO Global Business Service Award. Companies Want AI Agents, and Proof They Are Under Control AI is moving beyond chat toward agents that read data, call internal systems and complete multistep tasks on their own. That changes what companies ask. The question is no longer which AI tools to use, but who can use them, what data they touch and what the agents actually did. The gaps are already showing. Employees use personal AI accounts for work, leaving no company record. Agents built by individual teams run without IT's knowledge, sometimes long after the people who built them have left. When auditors ask for AI usage records, teams spend weeks pulling them together by hand. Regulation is adding pressure. The transparency obligations in Article 50 of the EU AI Act began applying in August 2026, and for Taiwanese companies that operate internationally, AI governance is now part of day-to-day operations. One Platform for Models, Agents and Automated Workflows AnyInsight is a zero-trust enterprise AI security and governance platform. Companies can build agents and automated workflows in a single environment, drawing on over 20 leading cloud models, 350-plus ready-to-use AI agents and more than 500 application connectors. Every AI interaction passes through a zero-trust generative AI firewall, which uses context-aware semantic analysis to detect personal, financial and health data as well as cloud credentials, and can alert on, block or mask that content in real time. Before an agent calls a tool through the Model Context Protocol (MCP), AnyInsight checks policy and authorizes access by role under the principle of least privilege. High-risk actions require human approval, and every event is logged as exportable audit evidence. AnyInsight Edge Takes Governance On-Premises On November 12, HEARTBOT AI announced AnyInsight Edge, which extends the same governance to on-premises environments and AI servers. Many companies bound by data residency rules or regulation have already deployed private large language models, only to find them stuck as internal chatbots with no access to core systems such as ERP, MES and CRM. Edge ships as a container, needs no GPU and can run in a company's data center or integrate with an AI server's operating system. A single control plane manages policy centrally and enforces it consistently across cloud and on-premises environments. On-premises models such as Gemma and Mistral get access to AnyInsight's agents, automated workflows and connectors, while AI conversations, transferred data and audit logs can stay in-house. "Companies stopped asking whether to use AI a while ago," said Nathan Yen, CEO of HEARTBOT AI. "What holds them back is that once agents multiply, nobody can say for sure what data they touched or what they did. AnyInsight gives every AI interaction and every agent action an owner and a record. Once companies can see that, they're willing to put AI into their core operations." "Recognition from the Meet Neo Star judges means a lot to a startup working on AI governance," Yen said. "A growing number of companies now treat control as a condition for adopting AI, and that's the problem we work on every day." About HEARTBOT AI HEARTBOT AI develops trustworthy, high-assurance enterprise AI solutions. Its flagship platform, AnyInsight, is a zero-trust enterprise AI security and governance platform with a built-in generative AI firewall, role-based access control (RBAC) and auditable activity logs. AnyInsight helps organizations protect sensitive data and enforce AI governance across platforms and networks. Enterprises can securely and rapidly connect their data and business applications, adopt AI agents and automated workflows to boost productivity and knowledge management, and keep complete records ready for compliance audits. AnyInsight is certified to ISO/IEC 27001:2022 for information security management, and its AI governance and data protection mechanisms are designed on the principles of the EU AI Act and the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). More information: AnyInsight | HEARTBOT AI

articles.title: IPCC at COP 31: UN climate science in geopolitical crossfire
articles.description: The climate conference in Antalya is currently addressing crucial issues related to the IPCC's report publication. Disputes over the timeline for these reports and the budget for 2027 remain unresolved. Developed nations advocate for early publication before the 2028 global stocktake, while developing countries oppose this. The differing priorities of emission reductions and adaptation to climate impacts have created tension among member countries.
